name: Heterkus
description: Heterkus was a planet in the Heterkus system, located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Around 0 BBY, the Galactic Empire's Commander Westen of the Relentless clashed with Adar Tallon and the Rebel Alliance at Heterkus.
lead_paragraphs: Heterkus was a planet in the Heterkus system, located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Around 0 BBY, the Galactic Empire's Commander Westen of the Relentless clashed with Adar Tallon and the Rebel Alliance at Heterkus.
